## `linear api administrable-teams [options]`

- What: All teams whose settings the user can administer. This includes teams the user can change settings for, but whose issues they may not have direct access to. This differs from the \`teams\` query which returns teams based on issue access.
- Call: `query administrableTeams`, effect: read
- Pages: cursor: send `after` (body), read the next one from `pageInfo.endCursor`; items in `nodes`; `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is false on the last page; page size in `first` (body)
- Body: `AdministrableTeamsRequest`

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--filter <value>` | no | Filter returned teams. |
| `--before <value>` | no | Returns results before this cursor. Pair with \`last\` to paginate backward, using a cursor returned by the same connection. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with \`first\` or \`after\`. |
| `--after <value>` | no | Returns results after this cursor. Pair with \`first\` and the previous page's \`endCursor\` to fetch the next page. Keep the filters and ordering unchanged between pages. Cannot be combined with \`last\` or \`before\`. |
| `--first <value>` | no | The maximum number of results to return, starting after \`after\` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Defaults to 50 when neither \`first\` nor \`last\` is supplied. Cannot be combined with \`last\` or \`before\`. |
| `--last <value>` | no | The maximum number of results to return, ending before \`before\` if supplied. Between 1 and 250. Cannot be combined with \`first\` or \`after\`. |
| `--include-archived <value>` | no | Includes archived resources alongside active ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active resources. This does not include deleted resources. |
| `--order-by <value>` | no | Orders results by creation time or last meaningful update time. Defaults to \`createdAt\`. Results are newest first with \`first\` and oldest first with \`last\`; use the returned \`endCursor\` as \`before\` to continue backward. Cannot be combined with custom \`sort\` options on fields that support them. |
| `--body <json>` | no | the request body as JSON; - reads it from stdin |
| `--body-file <path>` | no | the request body from a JSON file; - is stdin |
| `--all` | no | read every page, as the API pages it |

## `linear api application-info [options]`

- What: Looks up an OAuth application's name, developer, and branding using its OAuth clientId. Use this to identify an application before authorization. Private applications can be read only from their owning workspace; this lookup does not grant or install the application.
- Call: `query applicationInfo`, effect: read
- Body: `ApplicationInfoRequest`, required

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--client-id <value>` | no | The client ID of the application. |
| `--body <json>` | no | the request body as JSON; - reads it from stdin |
| `--body-file <path>` | no | the request body from a JSON file; - is stdin |

## `linear api archived-integrations`

- What: GitHub connections archived within the last 30 days, newest first. Connections dismissed from the reconnect list are omitted.
- Call: `query archivedIntegrations`, effect: read

## `linear api attachment-sources [options]`

- What: Lists distinct sources on accessible, non-archived issue attachments. API and OAuth attachment sources are grouped by URL domain; other sources are grouped by type. Each group includes the oldest attachment's source metadata. Results may be cached for up to one hour.
- Call: `query attachmentSources`, effect: read
- Body: `AttachmentSourcesRequest`

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--team-id <value>` | no | (optional) if provided will only return attachment sources for the given team. |
| `--body <json>` | no | the request body as JSON; - reads it from stdin |
| `--body-file <path>` | no | the request body from a JSON file; - is stdin |

## `linear api audit-entry-types`

- What: Lists supported audit action identifiers and a description of each action. Use the returned type values to interpret AuditEntry.type or filter auditEntries. Requires permission to view the workspace audit log.
- Call: `query auditEntryTypes`, effect: read

## `linear api authentication-sessions`

- What: Lists active browser, desktop, and mobile sign-in sessions for the authenticated account. isCurrentSession identifies the session making this request. Use a returned session ID with logoutSession to revoke a specific session. Requires session JWT authentication; API keys and OAuth access tokens do not provide this session list.
- Call: `query authenticationSessions`, effect: read

## `linear api available-users`

- What: Lists the signed-in account's workspace access. users contains memberships available with the current sign-in method; availableOrganizations contains workspaces the account may join. lockedUsers and lockedOrganizations identify workspaces that require another sign-in method, such as SAML. Each workspace membership has a different user ID even when it belongs to the same account.
- Call: `query availableUsers`, effect: read

## `linear api semantic-search [options]`

Returns ranked results without cursor pagination; maxResults controls the requested count, with extra exact matches or original issues possible. Limited to 30 requests per minute.

- Body: `SemanticSearchRequest`, required

| Flag | Required | What |
|---|---|---|
| `--query <value>` | no | A search phrase or natural-language description of what you are looking for, from 1 to 1024 characters. Results combine text matching with relevance by meaning. |

| `--max-results <value>` | no | The requested number of ranked search results, from 1 to 50; defaults to 50. Exact matches and original issues for matching duplicates can add results beyond this number. |
